lines.zh: 矿井的铁轨，还认得我的靴子。
lines.en: The mine rails still remember my boots.

lines.zh: 我穿墙而过，木梁拦不住。
lines.en: I pass through walls; the timber cannot stop me.

lines.zh: 脚步没有声音，只有灰尘落下。
lines.en: My steps make no sound, only dust falls.

lines.zh: 这条巷道走到头，是塌方。
lines.en: This tunnel ends at a cave-in.

lines.zh: 幽灵镐拖在身后，划出蓝光。
lines.en: My ghost pick drags behind, tracing blue light.

lines.zh: 我在矿脉上方走，石头是透明的。
lines.en: I walk above the veins; stone is transparent.

lines.zh: 旧矿车翻了，轮子还在转。
lines.en: The old cart tipped over, its wheel still turning.

lines.zh: 头顶的镐痕，是我生前留下的。
lines.en: The pick marks overhead were left by me alive.

lines.zh: 我不踩水洼，水也留不住我。
lines.en: I avoid puddles; water cannot hold me either.

lines.zh: 走了三百年，还是这条矿道。
lines.en: Three hundred years, still this same shaft.

lines.zh: 墙那边的矿石在轻轻响。
lines.en: The ore beyond the wall hums softly.

lines.zh: 别跟太近，我怕你又走丢。
lines.en: Do not follow too close; I fear you will get lost.

lines.zh: 矿井的木头霉了，我扶着走。
lines.en: The mine timber is rotten; I lean on it as I walk.

lines.zh: 一步一撮煤灰，急不得。
lines.en: A pinch of coal ash per step; no need to rush.

lines.zh: 风从矿口灌进来，吹散了我。
lines.en: Wind pours down the shaft and scatters me.

lines.zh: 矿井待久了，我才慢慢显形。
lines.en: Only after long hours in the mine do I show.

lines.zh: 飘飘停停，才是幽灵。
lines.en: Drift and pause; that is how a ghost moves.

lines.zh: 这里的煤味，正合我意。
lines.en: The smell of coal here suits me.

lines.zh: 我贴着铁轨慢慢飘过去。
lines.en: I drift along the rails, slowly.

lines.zh: 矿灯在左边，往那边飘。
lines.en: The mine lamp is to the left; I drift that way.

lines.zh: 我穿过墙，矿灯照不到我。
lines.en: I slip through the wall, beyond any lamp.

lines.zh: 矿道里的风，一直在吹。
lines.en: The draft in these shafts never stops.

lines.zh: 矿井的木板，我一穿就过。
lines.en: Mine planks, I pass straight through.

lines.zh: 我穿过石壁，慢慢往前走。
lines.en: I pass through the stone and walk on.

lines.zh: 我数着矿灯，一盏、两盏。
lines.en: I count the lanterns: one, then two.

lines.zh: 灵体不用呼吸，可我还是停了手。
lines.en: Spirits need no breath, yet I still pause.

lines.zh: 那块煤，生前是我挖的。
lines.en: That coal was mined by me when alive.

lines.zh: 矿壁里嵌着一根旧镐柄。
lines.en: An old pick handle is lodged in the wall.

lines.zh: 有人来矿井，多半不是好意。
lines.en: When someone enters the mine, it is rarely kind.

lines.zh: 我把镐子靠在肩上，等石头说话。
lines.en: I rest the pick on my shoulder, waiting for stone to speak.

lines.zh: 蜘蛛在角落结网，我不赶它。
lines.en: A spider webs the corner; I leave it be.

lines.zh: 这里太静，连回声都懒得来。
lines.en: It is so quiet even echoes do not bother.

lines.zh: 我记得阳光，但不记得温度。
lines.en: I recall sunlight, but not its warmth.

lines.zh: 矿洞的风，吹不动我的衣服。
lines.en: The draft cannot stir my clothes.

lines.zh: 该巡矿了，可我不急。
lines.en: Time to patrol the mine, but I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我在数废矿车上的锈钉。
lines.en: I count the rusted nails on the abandoned cart.

lines.zh: 我穿过矿井的墙，不留痕。
lines.en: I pass through mine walls without a trace.

lines.zh: 矿灯的光是甜的，你信吗。
lines.en: Mine lamp light tastes sweet; believe me?

lines.zh: 蘑菇从枕木缝里冒出来。
lines.en: Mushrooms push up between the sleepers.

lines.zh: 矿井里有人在外头挖。
lines.en: Someone is digging outside the mineshaft.

lines.zh: 我在想当年那场塌方。
lines.en: I am thinking of the cave-in, long ago.

lines.zh: 矿井废弃久了，我才出来。
lines.en: I come out once the mine is long abandoned.

lines.zh: 一百年，矿道又长了苔。
lines.en: A hundred years, and moss creeps back in.

lines.zh: 矿井里的墙，我穿过去就行。
lines.en: The mine walls; I simply pass through.

lines.zh: 矿道里我穿墙而过，石头不挡。
lines.en: In the shafts I pass through walls.

lines.zh: 矿井的每根木头，我都记得。
lines.en: I remember every timber in this mine.

lines.zh: 废弃矿井里，墙挡不住我。
lines.en: In the abandoned mine, walls don't stop me.

lines.zh: 矿井上面的阳光，别来打扰。
lines.en: Sunlight above the mine, don't disturb it.

lines.zh: 普通刀剑碰不到我，只有魔法。
lines.en: Steel can't touch me, only magic.

lines.zh: 安静，让我的影子歇一歇。
lines.en: Quiet now; let my shadow rest.

lines.zh: 矿顶滴水，我数着滴答。
lines.en: Water drips from the ceiling; I count the drops.

lines.zh: 废弃矿井里，我穿墙走。
lines.en: In the abandoned mine, I pass through walls.

lines.zh: 你是活人，呼吸声很响。
lines.en: You are alive; your breathing is loud.

lines.zh: 你的镐呢？空手进矿可不行。
lines.en: Where is your pick? Entering barehanded is unwise.

lines.zh: 我看你，不是看猎物。
lines.en: I look at you, but not as prey.

lines.zh: 你的灯太亮，矿石会躲。
lines.en: Your lamp is too bright; the ore will hide.

lines.zh: 别用那种眼神，我还记得人。
lines.en: Do not look at me so; I remember people.

lines.zh: 你身后那面墙，藏着铁。
lines.en: The wall behind you hides iron.

lines.zh: 你鞋底的泥，是从上层带下来的。
lines.en: The mud on your soles came from the level above.

lines.zh: 活人的眼睛，总是先看地面。
lines.en: Living eyes always look at the ground first.

lines.zh: 你要挖什么？我可以指路。
lines.en: What are you mining? I can point the way.

lines.zh: 你不怕我，倒让我不自在。
lines.en: Your lack of fear unsettles me.

lines.zh: 这么多年，只有矿车陪我。
lines.en: All these years, only the minecart kept me company.

lines.zh: 你就是地底矿工说的那个。
lines.en: So you're the one Underminer mentioned.

lines.zh: 这条矿道塌了，就归我。
lines.en: When this tunnel caved in, it became mine.

lines.zh: 矿道里，你的脚步带回声。
lines.en: In these tunnels, your steps come back as echoes.

lines.zh: 提着灯进矿道的，第几个了。
lines.en: How many lantern-carriers have come down here?

lines.zh: 你能走，却穿不过这堵墙。
lines.en: You can walk, but you cannot pass this wall.

lines.zh: 矿道里，我先穿墙过来。
lines.en: In the shaft, I come through the wall first.

lines.zh: 转过来，让我看你带没带符。
lines.en: Turn around and show whether you carry a charm.

lines.zh: 站到矿灯下，让我瞧瞧。
lines.en: Stand under the mine lamp and let me look.

lines.zh: 你的灯照不透我这身薄影。
lines.en: Your lantern cannot shine through my thin shadow.

lines.zh: 只有魔法能碰到我。
lines.en: Only magic can touch me.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我的指尖穿石而过。
lines.en: Do not touch me; my fingers pass through stone.

lines.zh: 灵体也会疼，只是不流血。
lines.en: Spirits feel pain too; they just do not bleed.

lines.zh: 这一下碰到了我的骨头，如果还有的话。
lines.en: That reached my bones, if I still have any.

lines.zh: 你的剑穿过去，像穿过雾。
lines.en: Your sword passes through like mist.

lines.zh: 疼，让我想起自己还在这儿。
lines.en: The pain reminds me I am still here.

lines.zh: 别用铁器，铁器对我不公平。
lines.en: Not iron; iron is unfair to me.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，矿灯晃了晃。
lines.en: I stepped back; the lantern swayed.

lines.zh: 这伤不会好，也不会要命。
lines.en: This wound will not heal, nor will it kill.

lines.zh: 你打中了，我记住了。
lines.en: You hit me; I will remember.

lines.zh: 我的镐差点脱手。
lines.en: My pick nearly slipped from my grip.

lines.zh: 再打，我可要还手了。
lines.en: Strike again, and I will hit back.

lines.zh: 只有魔法能伤到我，这一下是药水吧。
lines.en: Only magic hurts me — that was a potion, wasn't it?

lines.zh: 我身上的矿尘又厚一层。
lines.en: Another layer of mine dust settles on me.

lines.zh: 我这一身空灵，只有魔法碰得到。
lines.en: This ghostly body can only be touched by magic.

lines.zh: 记下了，下次绕到你背后。
lines.en: Noted; next time I come from behind.

lines.zh: 只有药水能碰到我。
lines.en: Only potions can touch me.

lines.zh: 疼得我想缩回矿井的墙里。
lines.en: It hurts enough to sink into the mine wall.

lines.zh: 我钉在矿道里，推不动。
lines.en: I am fixed in the tunnel; you cannot push me.

lines.zh: 我死在这矿里，已经很久了。
lines.en: I died in this mine a long, long time ago.

lines.zh: 我的脚没沾地，打不倒我。
lines.en: My feet do not touch the ground, so you cannot floor me.

lines.zh: 我这身子空灵，刀砍不进去。
lines.en: This body is spectral. Blades pass through.

lines.zh: 这块矿石，隔着口袋我也能看见。
lines.en: I can see that ore even through your pocket.

lines.zh: 别晃那块铁，光晃得我心慌。
lines.en: Do not wave the iron; its glow rattles me.

lines.zh: 金子的味道，比矿灯更暖。
lines.en: Gold smells warmer than any lantern.

lines.zh: 你把青金石放下，我就告诉你路。
lines.en: Set the lapis down, and I will show the way.

lines.zh: 红石在响，一下，又一下。
lines.en: The redstone ticks: once, and once more.

lines.zh: 我生前的口袋，也只装过煤。
lines.en: In life, my pockets held only coal.

lines.zh: 矿石离地一寸，我就想伸手。
lines.en: An ore an inch off the ground makes my hand twitch.

lines.zh: 放下镐，矿石归你，路归我。
lines.en: Lower your pick; the ore is yours, the path mine.

lines.zh: 这绿宝石，是谁从商人那儿换的？
lines.en: Who traded a merchant for this emerald?

lines.zh: 我不抢，只看，看完还给你。
lines.en: I will not take it; I only look, then return it.

lines.zh: 你包里那股铜味，是给我的？
lines.en: That copper smell in your pack, is it for me?

lines.zh: 你手里提灯的味道飘过来。
lines.en: The smell of your lantern drifts over.

lines.zh: 废弃矿井里，我穿过墙。
lines.en: In the abandoned mine, I pass through walls.

lines.zh: 你拿着火把做什么，放下。
lines.en: What are you doing with that torch? Put it down.

lines.zh: 你口袋里有矿石在响。
lines.en: Something ore-like clinks in your pocket.

lines.zh: 废弃矿井里，我的镐穿墙挖。
lines.en: In the mineshaft my pick digs through walls.

lines.zh: 我的手指，是指向你。
lines.en: My finger points at you.

lines.zh: 我的手自己伸出墙了。
lines.en: My hand reaches out of the wall on its own.

lines.zh: 你在矿井待太久了，我来了。
lines.en: You lingered in the mine too long — I'm here.

lines.zh: 矿井的味道，我怀念。
lines.en: I miss the smell of a mineshaft.

lines.zh: 别撞我，我身上只有凉气。
lines.en: Do not bump me; I am made of cold air.

lines.zh: 你穿过我的半边肩膀了。
lines.en: You passed through half of my shoulder.

lines.zh: 石头都拦不住我，何况你的胳膊。
lines.en: Stone cannot stop me, much less your arm.

lines.zh: 撞一下，矿灯就灭了。
lines.en: One bump and the lantern goes out.

lines.zh: 我的镐差点掉进你背包。
lines.en: My pick nearly fell into your pack.

lines.zh: 活人的体温，撞得我后退。
lines.en: The warmth of the living pushes me back.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子了，那影子很薄。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow; it is very thin.

lines.zh: 别慌，我不因碰撞动怒。
lines.en: Do not panic; a bump does not anger me.

lines.zh: 我让开，你也让开，各走各路。
lines.en: I step aside, you step aside; we part ways.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把灰尘撞成了人形。
lines.en: That bump knocked dust into a human shape.

lines.zh: 再穿我一次，我可要抓了。
lines.en: Pass through me again and I will grab back.

lines.zh: 我是灵体，你的脚碰不到我。
lines.en: I'm a spirit. Your feet pass through me.

lines.zh: 我早没痛觉，只是不高兴。
lines.en: I lost all feeling long ago; I am just displeased.

lines.zh: 退开，你踩得煤渣乱响。
lines.en: Back off; your steps rattle the coal dust.

lines.zh: 矿洞里我穿墙而过。
lines.en: In these mines I pass through walls.

lines.zh: 穿过墙，叶子掉了几片。
lines.en: Through the wall, minus a few leaves.

lines.zh: 我的旧矿帽被你撞歪了。
lines.en: You knocked my old mining cap askew.

lines.zh: 你撞我，跟撞一团烟一样。
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting a wisp of smoke.

lines.zh: 哎，我的矿灯！
lines.en: Hey, my mine lantern!

lines.zh: 矿车都刹得住，你刹不住。
lines.en: A minecart can brake; you cannot.

lines.zh: 我连影子都没有，谈什么后代。
lines.en: I have not even a shadow, let alone offspring.

lines.zh: 矿井里没有另一个我，只有回声。
lines.en: No other me in the mine, only echoes.

lines.zh: 生前没娶，死后更不必提。
lines.en: Unwed in life; less to say after death.

lines.zh: 你若见到穿矿工服的鬼，替我问好。
lines.en: If you meet a ghost in miner's clothes, greet it.

lines.zh: 灵体之间不结伴，怕互相穿透。
lines.en: Spirits do not pair up; they fear passing through each other.

lines.zh: 我的镐是唯一的家人。
lines.en: My pickaxe is the only family I keep.

lines.zh: 这矿井埋了我的同伴，也埋了我。
lines.en: This mine buried my companions, and me.

lines.zh: 繁殖是活人的事，我只守着矿脉。
lines.en: Breeding is for the living; I guard the veins.

lines.zh: 夜里我会喊一个名字，没人应。
lines.en: At night I call a name; no one answers.

lines.zh: 别说配对，我连手都握不实。
lines.en: Do not speak of pairing; I cannot even grip a hand.

lines.zh: 夜短，天亮前我们得走。
lines.en: The night is short; we must go before dawn.

lines.zh: 风正好，矿尘也正好。
lines.en: The draft is right, and so is the dust.

lines.zh: 慢一点，先交换矿灯的光。
lines.en: Slow down; let us trade lantern light first.

lines.zh: 我们会一起飘过这条矿道。
lines.en: We will drift down this tunnel together.

lines.zh: 你也死在这矿里吗，我等很久。
lines.en: Did you die in this mine too? I have waited so long.

lines.zh: 这盏旧矿灯，给你。
lines.en: This old mine lantern is for you.

lines.zh: 矿道尽头，我等你很久。
lines.en: At the tunnel's end, I have waited long.

lines.zh: 靠近些，矿车声太吵。
lines.en: Come closer; the carts are loud.

lines.zh: 废弃矿井里，花瓣全开了。
lines.en: In the abandoned mine, every petal opens.

lines.zh: 废矿井的支柱，我摸得着。
lines.en: I can feel the mine's rotting supports.

lines.zh: 这块铁我收下，就当是灯油钱。
lines.en: I take this iron as payment for lamp oil.

lines.zh: 我捡矿石，从不捡活人的行李。
lines.en: I pick up ore, never a living one's luggage.

lines.zh: 口袋漏风，矿石会掉出来。
lines.en: My pockets leak air; the ore will slip out.

lines.zh: 这块煤，我替你放回矿车。
lines.en: This coal I put back in the cart for you.

lines.zh: 拾起来容易，带走才难。
lines.en: Picking it up is easy; carrying it away is hard.

lines.zh: 我只拿一块，剩下的留给你。
lines.en: I take one piece and leave the rest to you.

lines.zh: 矿石压手，原来我还能感觉到重。
lines.en: The ore is heavy; so I can still feel weight.

lines.zh: 别把矿石丢在铁轨上，会绊人。
lines.en: Do not drop ore on the rails; it trips people.

lines.zh: 这绿宝石，我放到矿灯下面。
lines.en: I set this emerald beneath the lantern.

lines.zh: 捡完了，我数一遍，再还你。
lines.en: Once gathered, I count them, then return them.

lines.zh: 废弃矿井的墙，我穿得过去。
lines.en: The abandoned mine's walls let me through.

lines.zh: 我的手指从墙里把它勾住。
lines.en: My fingers hook it out through the wall.

lines.zh: 一枚旧钉子，够我高兴一天。
lines.en: One old nail is enough to please me all day.

lines.zh: 我在矿井里捡的东西，不还。
lines.en: What I pick up in the mine, I keep.

lines.zh: 这块煤，能烧很久吧。
lines.en: This lump of coal should burn a long while.

lines.zh: 矿井里捡的，不还。
lines.en: Found in the mineshaft. Not returning it.

lines.zh: 废弃矿井的墙，我穿得过去
lines.en: Abandoned mine walls let me through

lines.zh: 这块矿石穿墙也带得走。
lines.en: This ore comes through walls with me.

lines.zh: 矿井的镐头，锈了上百年。
lines.en: My pick has rusted a hundred years.

lines.zh: 先照一照，再塞进袋里。
lines.en: Let me shine it first, then pocket it.

lines.zh: 你先动了手，那就别怪我。
lines.en: You struck first; do not blame me now.

lines.zh: 镐尖抬起来了，它认得血。
lines.en: The pick rises; it remembers blood.

lines.zh: 我不伤活人，除非活人先伤我。
lines.en: I harm no living soul unless struck first.

lines.zh: 你背包里有我的矿石，我闻得到。
lines.en: My ore is in your pack; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 这一下，是替生前的自己。
lines.en: This blow is for the self I was alive.

lines.zh: 矿灯灭了，黑暗里我更快。
lines.en: The lamp dies; in darkness I am quicker.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了矿柱，整条巷道会塌。
lines.en: You broke a support; the whole tunnel may fall.

lines.zh: 我穿墙追你，墙不替你挡。
lines.en: I chase through walls; they will not shield you.

lines.zh: 别跑向竖井，那里没有底。
lines.en: Do not run for the shaft; it has no bottom.

lines.zh: 我的愤怒和矿井一样旧。
lines.en: My anger is as old as this mine.

lines.zh: 你把镐举反了，活人总是这样。
lines.en: You hold the pick backwards; the living always do.

lines.zh: 灵体也会记仇，记得比石头久。
lines.en: Even spirits hold grudges longer than stone.

lines.zh: 这一镐，只敲你脚边的石头。
lines.en: This swing hits only the stone by your feet.

lines.zh: 现在退后，我还能当作没发生。
lines.en: Step back now, and I can pretend this never happened.

lines.zh: 这本不该发生，你不该动手。
lines.en: This should not have happened. You struck first.

lines.zh: 矿井的墙挡不住我。
lines.en: The mine walls cannot hold me.

lines.zh: 活人的热气，好久没闻了。
lines.en: Living warmth; I have not smelled it in ages.

lines.zh: 就你了，今晚的灯油。
lines.en: You will do; tonight's lamp oil.

lines.zh: 只有魔法能碰到我的身体。
lines.en: Only magic touches this body.

lines.zh: 别跑，我穿墙比你快。
lines.en: Do not run; I cross walls faster than you.

lines.zh: 矿井的墙，我直接穿过去。
lines.en: I walk right through the mineshaft walls.

lines.zh: 别回头，铁镐就在你身后。
lines.en: Do not look back; the pick is behind you.

lines.zh: 废弃矿井的墙，我穿得过。
lines.en: Abandoned mine walls don't stop me.

lines.zh: 墙挡不住我，直接穿过去。
lines.en: Walls don't stop me — I pass through.

lines.zh: 废矿井里待久了就见到我。
lines.en: Linger in a mineshaft and I show up.

lines.zh: 你跑得比矿车快，可惜巷道是弯的。
lines.en: You outrun a cart, but the tunnel bends.

lines.zh: 我不用绕路，石头对我客气。
lines.en: I need no detour; stone is kind to me.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在矿洞里太清楚了。
lines.en: Your footsteps are far too clear in here.

lines.zh: 拐角后面是死路，我知道。
lines.en: Behind that corner is a dead end; I know.

lines.zh: 停下来，我不想把镐用在你身上。
lines.en: Stop; I would rather not use this pick on you.

lines.zh: 我的腿慢，可我不会累。
lines.en: My legs are slow, but I never tire.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，也照不到我。
lines.en: Raise your torch; it still will not find me.

lines.zh: 别躲在矿车后面，铁皮挡不住灵体。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the cart; tin stops no spirit.

lines.zh: 我数着你的心跳，越来越快。
lines.en: I count your heartbeat; it quickens.

lines.zh: 这条矿道我走过一万次。
lines.en: I have walked this shaft ten thousand times.

lines.zh: 你踩的每一块木板，我都听过。
lines.en: I have heard every plank you tread.

lines.zh: 前面塌方了，你只能回头。
lines.en: The way ahead has caved; you must turn back.

lines.zh: 我不喊，矿井会替我喊。
lines.en: I do not shout; the mine shouts for me.

lines.zh: 再跑三步，你就到我的镐下了。
lines.en: Three more steps and you are within my pick.

lines.zh: 我穿过岩壁，没有声音。
lines.en: I pass through the rock without a sound.

lines.zh: 我的镐在矿脉里引路。
lines.en: My pick leads the way through the vein.

lines.zh: 你回头，我正好在墙里。
lines.en: You turn, and I am inside the wall.

lines.zh: 我慢，可巷道的尽头是我。
lines.en: I am slow, but the tunnel's end is mine.

lines.zh: 你停下，我也会从墙里出来。
lines.en: If you stop, I will step out of the wall.

lines.zh: 矿井里待久了，我就醒了。
lines.en: Stay in the mine too long and I wake.

lines.zh: 你的鞋印，印在矿尘上。
lines.en: Your boot prints sit in the mine dust.

lines.zh: 你心跳太快，回声都乱了。
lines.en: Your heart races; the echoes fray.

lines.zh: 前面是死巷，我早知道。
lines.en: It is a dead end ahead; I knew already.

lines.zh: 你跑不出这几条矿道。
lines.en: You will not get out of these tunnels.

lines.zh: 每根矿柱都听过我的名字。
lines.en: Every support post has heard my name.

lines.zh: 你往哪拐，墙就替我拦。
lines.en: Whichever way you turn, the wall blocks you.

lines.zh: 支撑的木柱，正好挡你的路。
lines.en: The support beams are just in your way.

lines.zh: 墙对我没用，我穿过去。
lines.en: Walls don't stop me. I pass through.

lines.zh: 镐背敲肩，只让你疼一下。
lines.en: The pick's back strikes your shoulder, just a sting.

lines.zh: 我收了力道，活人经不起满镐。
lines.en: I held back; the living cannot take a full swing.

lines.zh: 这一下，是警告，不是处决。
lines.en: This blow is a warning, not an execution.

lines.zh: 幽灵镐穿过护甲，碰到骨头才停。
lines.en: The ghost pick passes armor, stopping at bone.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，很好，继续退。
lines.en: You stepped back twice; good, keep going.

lines.zh: 我打得慢，可每一镐都算数。
lines.en: I strike slowly, but every swing counts.

lines.zh: 疼痛会让你记住这条矿道。
lines.en: The pain will make you remember this shaft.

lines.zh: 别用手挡，镐刃是冷的。
lines.en: Do not block with your hand; the edge is cold.

lines.zh: 三下之内，你还能走。
lines.en: Within three blows, you can still walk.

lines.zh: 我把你往矿灯那边逼，那里亮。
lines.en: I drive you toward the lantern, where it is bright.

lines.zh: 这一镐砸在地上，碎石替你挡了。
lines.en: This swing hit the floor; gravel took it for you.

lines.zh: 你流血了，我却闻不到味道。
lines.en: You bleed, yet I cannot smell it.

lines.zh: 我生前也这样挨过一镐。
lines.en: I took a blow like this when I was alive.

lines.zh: 够了，放下武器，我停手。
lines.en: Enough; drop your weapon and I will stop.

lines.zh: 镐尖贴着你耳边过去。
lines.en: The pick tip passes by your ear.

lines.zh: 我推你一把，你撞上矿柱。
lines.en: I shove you into the mine post.

lines.zh: 一下就够了，穿墙不费劲。
lines.en: One blow is enough, walls don't slow me.

lines.zh: 倒吧，像那根矿柱那样。
lines.en: Fall, like that support post.

lines.zh: 废弃矿井里，我等你很久。
lines.en: In the mineshaft, I've waited long.

lines.zh: 穿过墙来，只为这一下。
lines.en: I passed through the wall just for this blow.

lines.zh: 矿井的规矩，我定的。
lines.en: I set the rules of this mine.

lines.zh: 废弃矿井的木头，一碰就碎。
lines.en: The old mine timber crumbles at a touch.

lines.zh: 我的铁镐从墙里劈出来。
lines.en: My pick swings out of the wall.

lines.zh: 穿墙过来，我连灰都没沾。
lines.en: Through the wall, and not a speck of dust on me.

lines.zh: 别躲，石头挡不住我的手。
lines.en: Do not dodge; stone cannot stop my hand.

lines.zh: 铁镐碰不到我，药水才行。
lines.en: Iron picks miss me — only potions land.

lines.zh: 废弃矿井又亮起一盏矿灯。
lines.en: A lantern lights again in the abandoned mine.

lines.zh: 我从岩壁里醒来，肩上还挂着镐。
lines.en: I wake from the rock, pick still on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一层的矿石，今天会显形。
lines.en: The ore on this level will show itself today.

lines.zh: 有人挖开了封死的巷道。
lines.en: Someone has opened the sealed tunnel.

lines.zh: 我闻到了新土和旧铁的味道。
lines.en: I smell fresh earth and old iron.

lines.zh: 三百年了，我还在原地报到。
lines.en: Three centuries, and I still report here.

lines.zh: 矿井记得我，所以我回来了。
lines.en: The mine remembers me, so I returned.

lines.zh: 幽灵镐在手里，比生前更轻。
lines.en: The ghost pick sits lighter than in life.

lines.zh: 我听见镐声，可惜不是我的。
lines.en: I hear a pick; sadly it is not mine.

lines.zh: 这一带的矿脉，我先看一遍。
lines.en: I will survey the veins here first.

lines.zh: 别点太多火把，矿石怕光。
lines.en: Do not light so many torches; ore fears light.

lines.zh: 我来了，石头让开了一条缝。
lines.en: I arrive, and the stone opens a seam.

lines.zh: 井下的空气，还是这股铁锈味。
lines.en: The air below still tastes of rust.

lines.zh: 生前的工牌，还挂在木柱上。
lines.en: My old work tag still hangs on the post.

lines.zh: 先让矿灯照我，再说话。
lines.en: Let the mine lamp find me first.

lines.zh: 谁在那边踢到了煤渣。
lines.en: Who is kicking the coal slag over there?

lines.zh: 这里，矿灯够亮吗。
lines.en: Is the mine lamp bright enough here?

lines.zh: 慢慢来，先让脚着地。
lines.en: Easy now; let your feet find the ground.

lines.zh: 我从这条旧矿道里醒来。
lines.en: I wake in this old mineshaft.

lines.zh: 睡太久了，连影子都硬。
lines.en: Asleep so long, even my shadow stiffened.

lines.zh: 新的矿工，新的脚步声。
lines.en: A new miner, and new footsteps.

lines.zh: 我从矿道墙里穿出来。
lines.en: I pass out through the mine wall.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁镐和汗的味道。
lines.en: I smell iron pick and sweat.

lines.zh: 我在矿道里等了很多年。
lines.en: I have waited in these tunnels many years.

lines.zh: 你在矿井待太久，我就来了。
lines.en: Stay in the mine too long and I appear.

lines.zh: 矿壁是湿的，我喜欢。
lines.en: I like how damp the tunnel walls are.

lines.zh: 火燎过灵体，像有人喊我名字。
lines.en: Fire sears a spirit like someone calling my name.

lines.zh: 火把，离我的矿尘远点！
lines.en: Torch, keep away from my mine dust!

lines.zh: 摔下去不疼，落地才疼。
lines.en: The fall is nothing; the landing hurts.

lines.zh: 摔下去，我的魂晃了一下。
lines.en: Falling through, my soul flickered.

lines.zh: 水漫过头顶，我早就不用呼吸。
lines.en: Water closes overhead; I stopped breathing long ago.

lines.zh: 水灌进矿道，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water floods the tunnel; I cannot rise.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹散，又慢慢聚回来。
lines.en: The blast scatters me; I slowly gather again.

lines.zh: 塌方了，我被炸散了。
lines.en: The tunnel caved; the blast scattered me.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，钉在身后的木梁上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and sticks in the beam.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，钉在枕木上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through me into a sleeper.

lines.zh: 魔法是真能伤我的，别再来一下。
lines.en: Magic truly hurts me; do not do it again.

lines.zh: 药水泼来，我的影子在散。
lines.en: Potion splashes and my shadow comes apart.

lines.zh: 灵体不会饿，可这空荡也难受。
lines.en: Spirits do not starve, yet this emptiness aches.

lines.zh: 矿井里待久了，我也饿。
lines.en: Long in this mine, and I am hungry too.

lines.zh: 雷声震得我差点散架。
lines.en: The thunder nearly shakes me apart.

lines.zh: 雷也算魔法，才碰得到我。
lines.en: Lightning counts as magic; it reaches me.

lines.zh: 虚空在拉我，矿井拽得更紧。
lines.en: The void pulls; the mine holds tighter.

lines.zh: 下面连矿脉都没有。
lines.en: There is not even an ore vein below.
